scoring_justification: The normal mode frequencies and critical field are outputs of a complex diagrammatic many-body computation that the verifier sandbox cannot redo; T0 result-level comparison against paper-derived gold with relative tolerances is the appropriate tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold normal mode frequencies (Omega_plus, Omega_minus) at E0=0.05, 0.10, 0.15 V/nm for μ=200meV, ℏω=2μ=400meV, T_e=300K, θ=0°.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4a,b — plotted mode frequencies vs field amplitude. Reference solve.sh produces these values as a correct implementation would.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the paper's mode-splitting plots at the three specified field amplitudes; consistent with Eq.(47) and the paper's parameter set.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported physical quantities for the specified parameter set; the reference oracle represents a correct solution pathway.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold critical field E_crit where lower shear mode vanishes.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4f and associated analysis — critical field at μ=200meV, ℏω=2μ, T_e=300K.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Value derived from the instability condition Ω−=0; confirmed consistent with the paper's analysis.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the paper-reported instability threshold; the reference solve.sh confirms a correct implementation yields this value.

outputs.description: Light-induced renormalized shear phonon frequencies at three electric field amplitudes.
Critical electric field amplitude at which the lower shear phonon mode vanishes, signaling a light-induced structural instability.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's reported values against hidden gold values extracted from the paper's figures, using relative tolerances appropriate for the numerical method (10% for frequencies, 20% for critical field). All model parameters and conditions are specified in the workflow steps.
